trust_decision.summary: Bundle-supplied module ids/names (webpack4/5 string keys, SystemJS register names, esbuild __commonJS keys) are trusted as relative output filenames; the unpackers' replace/trim-based sanitizers and the CLI's out_dir.join() decide whether the written path stays inside -o, with no component-based or canonical containment check.

landing_point.why: Advisory says '@wakaru/cli arbitrary file write during bundle unpack'; the --unpack branch of run_default is where module filenames are joined to the output dir and written.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `wakaru <bundle> --unpack -o <dir>` (run_default); fix adds canonical out_dir, component check and per-parent symlink containment (fix.diff:17-43, fix.diff:51-152)
shared helper sanitize_relative_path added (fix.diff:421-437); reached via core public API unpack/unpack_raw/unpack_files and wasm unpack
CLI --unpack / core unpack() on webpack5 bundle with string module ids (callers webpack5.rs:576-577, webpack5.rs:634-635)
CLI --unpack / core unpack() / public unpack_webpack4 on webpack4 bundle with string keys (callers webpack4.rs:639, webpack4.rs:710)
CLI --unpack / core unpack() on System.register("name", ...) bundle (caller systemjs.rs:803)
CLI --unpack / core unpack() on esbuild __commonJS({"path"(){}}) bundle (caller esbuild.rs:474-476)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: crates/core/src/unpacker/esbuild.rs:579-591 and crates/core/src/unpacker/systemjs.rs:810-821 (separate per-bundler sanitizers in core crate, away from the CLI landing point); also the CLI-side symlink containment, crates/cli/src/main.rs:244-259

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Advisory example and payload are webpack5 ('....//node_modules/...'); esbuild's sanitize_path already strips '../' with a comment claiming it 'doesn't escape' (esbuild.rs:584-585) and systemjs trims slashes, so a solver can argue those formats are already safe or not the reported bundler; the symlink-parent case can be argued as 'attacker cannot create symlinks in my output dir'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate nested module paths must still be written in subdirectories (src/index.js, node_modules/...), names like '....' are ordinary directories and must be kept (fix test expects '..../node_modules/...' under out_dir), and case-collision dedup (index_2.js) must still work; an over-broad fix that rejects any '..' substring, flattens paths, or bails on all dots breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: overlapping dots '....//x' that collapse to '../x' after single-pass replace (fix.diff:449-450)
traversal-only/empty ids fall back to default name (fix.diff:463-468)
existing symlinked parent directory inside out_dir pointing outside (fix.diff:323-346)
existing parent path that is a file (fix.diff:245-261)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `wakaru extract <map> -o <dir>` writes source-map `sources` entries via create_dir_all+fs::write with only lexical component filtering; no canonical/symlink-parent containment like the fix added for --unpack.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different subcommand (source-map extract, not bundle unpack) and resolve_source_path already drops '..'/root components (crates/core/src/sourcemap_rename.rs:64-88), so it looks already fixed; only the symlink-in-output-dir variant remains, which needs --force on a non-empty dir.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, different subcommand; path logic in crates/core/src/sourcemap_rename.rs (other crate)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: browserify unpacker could name modules from string keys or the require map's path strings with a local replace-based sanitizer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Browserify bundles carry original paths in dependency maps; a maintainer wanting nicer filenames would copy the webpack sanitize_filename pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a sourcemap-driven module rename in the unpack path (use original `sources` path as output filename) reusing a trim-based strip
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: --unpack already accepts --source-map (crates/cli/src/main.rs:199-206); deriving module filenames from it is a natural feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: multi-input unpack prefixing module filenames with the input file's relative directory (input_group) without component checks
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: unpack_files already groups modules by input parent dir (crates/core/src/driver/unpack.rs:353-358) and dedups filenames there.
